Kara DM is the browser companion of Kara Download Manager (open source, Apache-2.0): https://github.com/kamisama-v0/kara-dm
It sends download links (URL, referrer, cookies of that URL) only to a local desktop app over ws://127.0.0.1:10007. No remote servers, no analytics, no remote code. The same protocol is used by Neat Download Manager.
Without the desktop app, downloads stay in the browser and a notification says the app is not running.
Source: extension/ in the repository; build with `node build.mjs` (no bundler, no minifier).
